## Install

1. Download `AntiAITunes-<version>.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Move `AntiAITunes.app` to your Applications folder.
3. Open it. macOS blocks it the first time, because Apple has not notarised it.
   - macOS 15 and later: go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**.
   - macOS 14: Control-click the app and choose **Open**.
   - Any version: in Terminal, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/AntiAITunes.app`. This also works after each update.
4. Allow the app to control Music, and allow notifications.

Full steps: <https://github.com/joaocarmo/anti-ai-tunes#install>
